result.title: When Parameter Gradient Flows Close in Representation Space
result.comment: 34 pages, 2 figures; code and numerical data included as ancillary files
result.summary: The represented gradient flow of a parameterized model depends on a mobility that can retain hidden parameter information. We study when one entire represented mobility map works for every autonomous loss from one fixed initialization. For two-factor matrix representations wider than both output dimensions, with individually full-row-rank factors, we classify all admissible joint ranks: closure occurs precisely at effective scalar-balanced minimal joint rank or a two-value signed spectral family at full joint rank. All intermediate ranks are excluded; positive represented flows belong to known square-root families. For general representations with constant ambient representation and gradient-Lie ranks, ordinary closure is equivalent to a local invariant-level metric in the analytic case and specified smooth regimes. An endpoint section forces the initially unrestricted mobility map to admit a locally smooth representative on the represented image. We also separate testing families: linear losses locally admit closure at every submersion, whereas one fixed translated strongly convex quadratic family fails it on a delayed-bracket example. A fixed output readout gives an ordinary squared-loss witness. These supporting results do not characterize quadratic-only closure in general. We retain the unresolved smooth output-rank-two case with Lie rank at least four. A frozen deterministic experiment checks a separate engineered-loss construction; it is distinguished from the squared-loss proof, universal theorems and empirical learning performance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从理论上研究参数化模型的「表示梯度流」何时闭合：即同一 mobility 映射能否对固定初始化下的任意自治损失通用。作者对宽于输出维度的两因子矩阵表示给出可容许联合秩的完整分类（仅标量平衡的最小联合秩或全秩的带符号谱族），并在一般表示下证明普通闭合性等价于解析情形中的局部不变层度量，另用线性损失与平移强凸二次族的反例做分离。
AI.relevance_reason: 「表示空间中的流是否闭合、由不变层度量刻画」可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态能否在表示空间内自洽更新、以及表示几何对轨迹有效性的约束形成概念类比，可供核查；但该文为纯数学设定，与视觉多模态推理无直接联系。
